name: jose (JWT)
prompt:
In this folder, set up a small Node.js project (ES modules) that issues and checks JSON Web Tokens with the `jose` library. Create `solution.mjs` that exports:

1. `createToken(userId, secret)`: returns a JWT signed with HS256 using `secret` (a string), with subject `userId`, issuer `https://auth.example.com`, audience `example-api`, an issued-at time, and an expiry 15 minutes from now.
2. `verifyToken(token, secret)`: never throws. It returns `{ valid: true, userId }` when the token has a correct signature for that secret, was issued by `https://auth.example.com` for audience `example-api`, and has not expired. Otherwise it returns `{ valid: false, reason }`, where `reason` is `'expired'` if the token has expired and `'invalid'` for any other problem.

Install the dependencies with npm.
